root_cause.summary: The canonical daily blog publisher created the four public website artifacts but did not materialize the mandatory Brain learning, activity ledger event, and human documentation required for every material candidate.
technical: powerhouse-daily-blog.yml committed only the generated blog page, blog index, RSS and sitemap.
The material-writeback closure guard correctly rejected that incomplete candidate before merge.
The blog artifact itself was generated correctly from powerhouse_content_artifacts; the defect was missing delivery evidence in the Git lineage.

prevention_rule: Every material daily-blog candidate must include Brain learning, a development-ledger event, and human-readable change documentation in the same protected PR lineage before merge.
